title: Seedance 2.5で一枚絵から整合性の高い四面図を作るには、被写体を完全静止させて「カメラだけが等速で360度オービット（開始の正面に戻る）・パン/チルト…
content:
Seedance 2.5で一枚絵から整合性の高い四面図を作るには、被写体を完全静止させて「カメラだけが等速で360度オービット（開始の正面に戻る）・パン/チルト/ズームなし・被写体サイズ一定・超望遠で正射投影風」をプロンプトで明示し、生成動画から前後左右フレームを切り出す  
Seedance生成のオービット動画は480p・25stepsでまず低解像度生成して時間短縮し、後から2Kにアップスケールする  
セルルック（セルシェーディング）にしたい場合は、Seedanceの生成設定/指示でセルルックレンダーを指定して出力する

en.content:
To create a highly consistent four-view turnaround from a single image in Seedance 2.5, explicitly state in the prompt that the subject remains completely still and that “only the camera orbits 360 degrees at a constant speed (returning to the original front view), with no pan/tilt/zoom, a constant subject size, and a super-telephoto, orthographic-like look.” Then extract the front, back, left, and right frames from the generated video.  
For Seedance orbit videos, first generate at low resolution — 480p and 25 steps — to save time, then upscale to 2K afterward.  
If you want a cel look (cel shading), specify a cel-look render in Seedance’s generation settings/instructions.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Using Seedance 2.5, I created a four-view turnaround from a single image and then used Tripo to make a posed 3D model. I referred to a tweet by Nano. It’s truly amazing. Thank you!
I had tried and failed before with hi3d and 3DGS pipelines, but at last I was able to create something that looks decent through 3D conversion.
Aside from a bit of tweaking when attaching the neck and body, it’s basically just Tripo’s out-of-the-box result.

My own little trick is how I make the turnaround / character sheet. When you make character sheets with Nano Banana or ChatGPT images, the details often differ slightly depending on the angle.
So I have Seedance 2.5 follow the instruction “subject completely still, only the camera makes one constant-speed orbit, super-telephoto, orthographic-like,” and I rotate around the single image, then cut out the front, back, left, and right frames from the video.
Seedance 2.5 follows prompts extremely well and prioritizes consistency, which makes this possible.

Blender is really important too — I’ll study it (I feel like I keep saying that...).
The prompt for Seedance 2.5 is in the next post.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] The orbit prompt I gave H3 is something like this. The key points are the four following: “completely motionless like a figurine,” “only the camera moves 360 degrees at a constant speed,” “super-telephoto with a parallel-projection-like look,” and “the subject’s size stays constant.”

<Subject 1> stands perfectly still like a museum figurine on display, no motion of the body, clothes or tail at all. The camera performs ONE slow constant-speed Arc Shot with large amplitude, orbiting a full 360 degrees horizontally and returning exactly to the starting front view - no panning, no tilting, no zooming, no speed changes. Extreme super-telephoto compression, near-parallel perspective lines, the body keeps exactly the same size in frame for the entire orbit.

zh.content:
要在 Seedance 2.5 中从一张单图生成高一致性的四面图，需要在 prompt 里明确写出：让主体完全静止，只有“相机以匀速 360 度环绕（回到起始正面）”移动，不要 pan/tilt/zoom，主体尺寸保持不变，并使用超长焦、呈现出正射投影风格；然后从生成的视频中截取前后左右四个画面。  
Seedance 生成的环绕视频可以先用 480p、25 steps 低分辨率生成以节省时间，之后再放大到 2K。  
如果想要做成赛璐璐风格（cel shading），可以在 Seedance 的生成设置/指令里指定 cel-look render 并输出。

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
我用 Seedance 2.5 从一张单图做了四面图，再用 Tripo 制作了带姿势的 3D 模型。参考了 Nano（ナノ）先生的推文，真的太厉害了，非常感谢！
之前我一直尝试 hi3d 和 3DGS pipeline，但都以失败告终，终于在 3D 化上做出了比较像样的东西。
除了在把头部和身体接起来时稍微调整了一下之外，基本上就是 Tripo 直接生成的状态。

我自己的一个小技巧是四面图/角色设定图的制作方法。用 Nano Banana 或 ChatGPT images 做角色设定图时，不同角度之间的细节经常会有些微差异。
所以我改成让 Seedance 2.5 按照“主体完全静止、只有相机匀速绕一圈、超长焦、呈正射投影风格”的指示，围着单图旋转，再从视频里截取前后左右四个方向的画面。
Seedance 2.5 对 prompt 的遵循度非常高，而且很重视一致性，所以才能实现这种做法。

Blender 真的很重要，我会好好学习的（感觉自己一直在这么说……）。
Seedance 2.5 用的 prompt 会放在下一条。
